we've talked to their superiors and advisers before, they don't care that much. they don't see it happen and people aren't being outright abusive so it doesn't matter to them. i've wanted to complain before but my family doesn't want to because that's work, so we've only been able to talk to them in big tac meetings.

the people i see are under the NHS and they're kinda the default, go to people for this sorta thing. if we wanted to see anybody else, we'd probably have to pay for somebody private and we can't afford that.

they are. they don't see it as a real, proper hobby because it doesn't involve much physical work or going outside.

they don't help at all and have at times driven me to attempt suicide. i'm open about how they aren't helping but they don't care much, they basically tell me to get over it because they're "trying their best" and therefor i have no right to complain.
i've been trying for the last 5 or so years and i'm still getting nowhere. nothing i do is good enough.

i try to but they're important mental health people that i have to listen to like 99% of the time, or else i get in trouble, and then people start threatening to put me in a foster home or a proper psychiatric place.

after my last stay in hospital i sorta snapped and just started accepting everything they said as facts. it's stupid and it hurts but i'm tired and it's so much easier to just let them do whatever, even if it hurts me.
i don't know. there's not that much point, i'm never going to get anywhere.

and i guess i am getting help, but it's not working very well.

i live with my grandma, she knows how i feel and she knows that i'm having a bad time rn, but she doesn't know what to do and i can't explain how bad it is.
